milestone: Resident batched native FP16 dense projection
status: Qualified CUDA component on pinned system cuBLAS; whole inference/vLLM objective remains active

implementation.weights: Immutable backend-owned packed [K,N] FP16, created through bounded native block-row materialization. Source checkpoint remains unchanged.
implementation.execution: Request-owned streams and cuBLAS handles. FP16 input and FP16 or FP32 output, full matrix geometry, COMPUTE_32F/default math. No bias or implicit conversions.
implementation.workspace: 48 MiB explicit request payload: dedicated 32 MiB for FP16 torch.matmul policy plus shared 16 MiB original F32 hgemm/trellis fallback. Setup-only, idempotent; existing trellis profile unchanged. Other library/context/resident allocations excluded.
implementation.validation: Reject wrong backend/request/shape/type/count or overlapping views before queuing. Device errors poison request. Teardown drains stream before handles/workspaces are freed.

validation.synthetic: Exact dyadic integer dot products, 1x1/35x67/128x128 shapes, guards, rejection without output mutation, two request streams sharing one weight.
validation.reference: Paired system CUDA libraries only. Unchanged Torch forward AST for FP16; original F32 hgemm argument replay for FP32. Not original compiled extension or whole-model forward parity.

warmed.scope: Warmed native Engram wkv weight, M1024 K6144 N25600; 32 repeated FP16+FP32 output pairs, request-local stream/workspace. Capture delimiters excluded from no-synchronization statement.
warmed.limitations: One projection shape per capture. First-call capture includes GPU library module loads; no explicit allocation/copy/synchronization API does not imply no implicit library/driver memory or cold-start delay. No complete layer, generation, cold storage, CPU, Metal or vLLM throughput/latency parity claim.

cold.scope: First-call native Engram wkv weight, M64 K6144 N25600; 32 repeated FP16+FP32 output pairs, request-local stream/workspace. Capture delimiters excluded from no-synchronization statement.

numerical_findings.workspace: System cuBLAS: m6 Engram wkv M64 had 1287 FP16 differences with 16 MiB; 32 MiB exactly matches unchanged torch.matmul. Independent sweep held inputs/weights/source fixed and tested 1/4/8/16/32/64 MiB, math modes 0/1/16/17 and algorithms -1/99.

cross_version.note: Original Torch-packaged versus paired system CUDA outputs differ. No bitwise equivalence claim across these library versions. Original references were retained.

prior_attempts.initial_cuda_suite: One launch timeout in existing prefill-window test; no numeric failure in new checks. Focused flag lacked return and was corrected. A manually stopped rerun was superseded by subsequent clean passing suites.
prior_attempts.initial_native_reference: 281319216 mismatches across three repeats against Torch-packaged cuBLAS. Oracle preserved.
prior_attempts.paired_system_before_workspace_fix: 3861 mismatches (1287 repeated three times) only m6 M64 FP16; independent workspace sweep isolated 16 MiB versus Torch default 32 MiB. Both original output sets preserved.

limitations: Dense projection primitive only; complete numeric config, global core budgets/parameter assembly, HC4, routing, compressed shared/indexed attention, Engram and generation remain unfinished.
F32 reference replays original hgemm arguments rather than executing the compiled original extension. FP16 uses unchanged original LinearFP16.forward AST.
COMPUTE_32F/default math does not promise all internal vendor reductions stay FP32. Qualification covers pinned libraries, captured tensors and batch sizes.
Profiles cover warmed M1024 and first-call-after-setup M64 Engram wkv. No whole-model cold storage, throughput, latency, CPU/Metal execution or vLLM parity claim.
